Functions for imputing missing item responses for dichotomous and
polytomous test and assessment data. This package enables missing
imputation methods that are suitable for test and assessment data,
including: listwise (LW) deletion (see De Ayala et al. 2001
\<[doi:10.1111/j.1745-3984.2001.tb01124.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1745-3984.2001.tb01124.x)\>),
treating as incorrect (IN, see Lord, 1974 \<[doi:
10.1111/j.1745-3984.1974.tb00996.x](https://doi.org/%2010.1111/j.1745-3984.1974.tb00996.x)\>;
Mislevy & Wu, 1996 \<[doi:
10.1002/j.2333-8504.1996.tb01708.x](https://doi.org/%2010.1002/j.2333-8504.1996.tb01708.x)\>;
Pohl et al., 2014 \<[doi:
10.1177/0013164413504926](https://doi.org/%2010.1177/0013164413504926)\>),
person mean imputation (PM), item mean imputation (IM), two-way (TW) and
response function (RF) imputation, (see Sijtsma & van der Ark, 2003
\<[doi:
10.1207/s15327906mbr3804_4](https://doi.org/%2010.1207/s15327906mbr3804_4)\>),
logistic regression (LR) imputation, predictive mean matching (PMM), and
expectation–maximization (EM) imputation (see Finch, 2008 \<[doi:
10.1111/j.1745-3984.2008.00062.x](https://doi.org/%2010.1111/j.1745-3984.2008.00062.x)\>).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`EMimpute()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/EMimpute.md)
  : EM Imputation
- [`ImputeTestData()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/ImputeTestData.md)
  : This main function imputes for missing responses using selected
  method
- [`ItemMean()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/ItemMean.md)
  : Item Mean (IM) Imputation
- [`Listwise()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/Listwise.md)
  : Listwise Deletion (LW)
- [`LogisticReg()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/LogisticReg.md)
  : Logistic Regression (LR) Imputation
- [`micePMM()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/micePMM.md)
  : Predictive mean matching (PMM)
- [`PersonMean()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/PersonMean.md)
  : Person Mean Imputation (PM)
- [`ResponseFun()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/ResponseFun.md)
  : Response Function Imputation (RF)
- [`test.data`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/test.data.md)
  : Example test data
- [`TreatIncorrect()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/TreatIncorrect.md)
  : Treat missing responses as incorrect (IN)
- [`Twoway()`](https://daiscode.github.io/TestDataImputation/reference/Twoway.md)
  : Two-Way Imputation (TW)
